lines.2: Yoshimi was still staring blankly into space.
lines.4: Maybe I should get her something nourishing to eat.
lines.5: We were running low on tissues and other daily necessities too. I should restock those.
lines.6: 「I'm going shopping for a bit. Want to come?」
lines.9: The kitchen knife sitting out and the razor in the washroom made me uneasy.
lines.10: Was it really safe to leave her alone?
lines.12: She was just sitting there in a daze.
lines.13: All right. I'd get the shopping done fast.
lines.16: I'd need to call Otome later and smooth things over with her.
lines.17: In the end, I was going to have to stay here a little longer.
lines.19: I noticed clover growing in an empty lot.
lines.20: 「Yoshimi likes charms and things like that. Maybe she'd like this too.」
lines.24: Something symbolic like this might help her in the state she was in.
lines.28: She still had no energy, just staring into space.
lines.29: 「Come on. Don't let it crush you this badly...」
lines.30: Maybe, now that she'd calmed down, she couldn't forgive herself for almost betraying the Princess.
lines.31: 「It doesn't change the fact that I like you.」
lines.32: 「But... when I think about it calmly, I was jealous every time you talked to anyone...」
lines.33: 「In the end I'm no different from my mother at all...」
lines.34: 「Running a negative campaign on yourself now?」
lines.41: Good. A smile suited her best after all.
lines.42: 「Leo, you're such an idiot... That's not what this is.」
lines.44: 「This is white clover. There isn't any scientific name called a 'lucky clover'...」
lines.46: Then she tore the clover apart.
lines.48: She kept laughing bitterly, though I had no idea what she found funny.
lines.49: That was when I realized this was genuinely serious.
lines.51: 「Was it wrong for me to hit you?」
lines.53: For now, I would stay beside her.
lines.54: I sat down next to her and held her hand.
lines.56: 「Maybe you're the type who helps someone with a handicap just so you can feel superior...」
lines.58: 「You're thinking I'm gloomy and pathetic for falling apart over a past like that, aren't you?」
lines.59: 「You don't have to force yourself like this!」
lines.60: It felt like she was deliberately trying to make me hate her.
lines.61: She didn't need to throw herself away like this.
lines.62: Maybe she was simply far too serious at heart.
lines.63: Everything about her went to extremes.
lines.64: 「...Leo, I'm surprised you haven't abandoned me after seeing me like this.」
lines.65: 「Because I keep telling you I love you!」
lines.66: 「I told you, didn't I? I'll accept all of you...」
lines.67: 「All of me...? That's just a pretty line.」
lines.68: 「Say whatever you want. I'm not moving from here.」
lines.69: I still thought I'd made the right choice.
lines.70: What Yoshimi needed right now was someone staying beside her.
lines.71: 「Why does the weather have to be this awful...? Damn it.」
lines.72: I wished the sky would clear.
lines.74: 「Yoshimi, we're almost at school. Are you okay?」
lines.77: 「You said you'd accept all of me, didn't you?」
